Establish a deterministic priority order over externally observable obligations and commit exactly one bounded, reproducible anchor-negative terminal postcondition. Return exactly one WITNESS record with the procedure, observed anchor trace, failed predicate, preservation predicates, and falsifier. Do not emit source, patches, implementation advice, alternatives, rankings, or engine-tuning instructions.

Consume the untouched anchor and terminal_obligation_witness. Trace actual control and state dependencies backward from the failed terminal predicate and emit exactly one minimal PREIMAGE_CLOSURE with typed prerequisite nodes and edges, anchor facts, satisfaction predicates, preservation boundary, deterministic dependency order, and unresolved assumptions. Do not create corridor contracts, alternate closures, source, patches, candidates, or rankings.

Treat the champion artifact as the untouched source authority and the fixed causal preimage as the sole implementation contract. Produce exactly one complete legal production engine in one working lineage by realizing every prerequisite directly at its bound responsibility site and propagating it through the fixed edges. Preserve native identity custody and ordinary deterministic reconstructions, but delete the corridor composer and do not create any corridor, carrier, quotient, certificate, alternate lineage, or shared normalization. Replay the witness and verify syntax, public source-contract, UCI, legal-move, state-integrity, determinism, timing-safety, and applicable perft checks. Repair the same engine at the earliest unmet authorized obligation and return only the final engine artifact.
